correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all signed facet forms and radius linear-program dual constraints. Their extreme positive dependencies have at most three nonzero forms, split (up to the square symmetry) into opposite pairs, Type I (1,1,k) and Type II (2,k,k), k=1+w. Analyzed the sharp upper obstructions min(3k/2,2)/(k+2) and min(2k,3)/(2+2k); independently tested every explicit witness triple via LP radius and diameter at rational k=101/100,6/5,4/3,7/5,3/2,17/10,199/100, obtaining exact expected overall max profile. Circuit maxima and the k=√2 crossing analytically entail all parameters; sampled LP checks are corroboration only.
residual_risks: The numerical LP spot check uses double precision and does not by itself establish infinite parameter coverage; analytic dual facet inequalities and constructive triples are essential.
